description: This file is a shell script defining the API and functions for managing services with procd, a process launcher and supervisor used in embedded Linux systems like OpenWrt. It provides functions for opening/closing services and instances, setting parameters, controlling service state, and interacting with ubus, json, and config utilities.

methods.name: procd_open_service
methods.description: Initializes a new service, optionally with a script

methods.name: procd_close_service
methods.description: Finalizes and sends the command message for a service

methods.name: procd_open_instance
methods.description: Adds an instance to the current service

methods.name: procd_set_param
methods.description: Sets a parameter of a specific type for the current service or instance

methods.name: procd_running
methods.description: Checks if a service or specific instance is running

methods.name: procd_kill
methods.description: Kills a service or specific instance

methods.name: procd_send_signal
methods.description: Sends a specified signal to a service or instance

methods.name: procd_add_mdns
methods.description: Adds mDNS services to the data structure

methods.name: uci_validate_section
methods.description: Validates a configuration section using UCI

methods.name: uci_load_validate
methods.description: Validates and optionally processes a UCI configuration section
